title: Go (Golang) Essentials
description: Write fast, statically typed backend services with Go: slices, structs, interfaces, explicit errors, goroutines, channels, and net/http APIs.
outcomes: Build clean, idiomatic Go packages with strong static typing
Model data with structs, methods, and implicit interfaces
Write concurrent pipelines using goroutines, channels, and sync.WaitGroup
Ship a JSON REST API with standard-library net/http and context cancellation
